simple.meaning: אַרְוַד (ʼArvad) is a Hebrew word meaning “Arvad , an island-city of Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַרְוַד (H719) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 27:8, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַרְוַד (H719) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַרְוַד (H719) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אַרְוַד (ʼArvad) / H719 is traced through Ezekiel 27:8, Ezekiel 27:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
